newsitem.title: USA: Koppers Industries to close Houston plant.
newsitem.headline: Koppers Industries to close Houston plant.

text.p: Koppers Industries Inc said Thursday it had decided to close the Houston facility of its carbon materials and chemicals division, and will consolidate its coal tar distillation production at its remaining plants.
The Houston plant, which processed about 9.0 percent of the coal tar that is processed by all of its distillation plants, is scheduled to close at year-end, it said.
The company said it will help the plant's 27 employees find new jobs within its other plants.
The company's coal tar distillation plants are in Clairton, Pa., Woodward, Ala., Follansbee, W.V., and Stickney, Ill.
